note_en: 越……越…… is Chinese for "the more... the more...": 一盘菜越用心调味，味道就越丰富 "the more care you put into seasoning a dish, the richer its flavor." Unlike English, there is no comparative form: 越 simply goes before each verb or adjective (丰富, not "richer"), and 就 often links the second half. Compare 等级越高，考核的内容就越复杂 later in the text.
